say:1:1231196001:1.text: The harbor was blocked, but there's still a safe stretch of sea not far off the coastline.
say:1:1231196001:1.source_cn: 港口是被封锁了，但在离海岸线不远的地方，还有一片相对安...

say:2:1231196002:1.text: Fishing boats don't venture far. Even with the risks, folks have to tough it out to make a living.
say:2:1231196002:1.source_cn: 捕鱼的小船不会走远。就算有些风险，大家也得硬着头皮去讨生活。

say:3:1231196003:1.text: You've got the potential choice of starving to death or getting swallowed by a monster out at sea. Fun times.
say:3:1231196003:1.source_cn: 唉，要么饿死，要么被海怪吞噬，葬身海底，总得选一个。
